note: empty token has no glyph to focus
the punctuation decision, isolated: bare 'movements' is 9 -> 2, the comma makes it 10 -> 3
same, across the 13/14 boundary: bare form is 13 -> 3
BMP non-ASCII: 6 code points == 6 UTF-16 units, so nothing to normalize
BMP CJK: 3 code points == 3 UTF-16 units
ASTRAL: 5 code POINTS -> row 2-5 -> 1. A UTF-16-code-UNIT implementation counts 6 -> row 6-9 -> 2 and FAILS
ASTRAL: 3 code points -> 1. A code-unit impl agrees on the index here (4 units -> 1) but slices token[1] as a lone surrogate — see rsvp_focus_offset_cases.json
ASTRAL (math fraktur): 3 code points -> 1; a code-unit impl counts 6 -> 2 and FAILS
ASTRAL, single glyph: 1 code point -> row <=1 -> 0; a code-unit impl counts 2 -> 1, i.e. the emoji's LOW surrogate
ASTRAL crossing two breakpoints: 5 code points -> row 2-5 -> 1, but 10 units -> row 10-13 -> 3
ASTRAL across the 13/14 breakpoint: 7 astral + 6 ASCII = 13 code points -> 3, but 20 units -> row >=14 -> 4

MALFORMED, documented: an UNPAIRED surrogate counts as exactly ONE unit (one Python str element, one Array.from element), so 3 -> 1. It renders as tofu everywhere, but all three renderers agree on the index and the pivot
MALFORMED: a bare unpaired surrogate is a length-1 token, never merged with a neighbour that is not there
NFD 'e' + COMBINING ACUTE: normalised to NFC first, so it is ONE code point -> 0. Without the NFC pin it is 2 -> row 2-5 -> index 1, i.e. the focus glyph would be the bare combining mark
NFD 'no' with a tilde: NFC is 2 code points -> 1. The index happens to match the un-normalised one; rsvp_focus_slices_cases pins the part that does not (the mark vs 'o')
NFD 'naive' with a diaeresis: NFC is 5 code points -> row 2-5 -> 1. Without the NFC pin it is 6 -> row 6-9 -> 2, so it also crosses a breakpoint
NFD 'cafe' with an acute: NFC is 4 -> 1, same as the composed spelling — the two forms must never disagree
The SAME token already in NFC: identical answer to the NFD spelling above, which is the whole point of normalising
RESIDUAL, accepted delta: U+0348 has NO precomposed form, so NFC leaves 2 code points and the focus glyph IS the combining mark. Documented, not solved — Unicode has nothing to compose it to
